title: FindingReport@1 payload
description: One immutable claim by one reviewer attempt about one subject snapshot. Reports are never merged or edited: the projection may ATTACH a report to a Finding, but attachment groups claims for adjudication and does not collapse their verification obligations. The reporting reviewer, node, attempt and subject snapshot live in the artifact envelope, not here.

title.description: Stable one-line claim. A dedupe hint only — never proof of claim identity.

severity.description: Reported rank. Monotone under re-report: a later report may raise it, never lower it.

locations.description: Where the claim applies. Empty means change-wide; there is no sentinel path for it.

body.description: The argument: what is wrong and why, with enough detail to reproduce or refute.

fix.description: The reviewer's proposed remedy. Required — the legacy findings schema also required it, and the legacy ledger then stored it nowhere, which is the field a triager most wants. A patch, if any, is a separate PatchProposal@1.

confidence.description: Reviewer's own confidence. Evidence, not authority: it can never grant auto-apply or resolve a finding.

failure_trace.description: Verbatim reproduction output, if the claim was reproduced. Large traces belong in a content object referenced from the envelope.

rule_id.description: Globally namespaced, versioned rule identity, e.g. review.rules.perf/quadratic-scan@2.

occurrence_key.description: Stable semantic occurrence key defined by the rule. ONLY an exact occurrence-key match may auto-attach a report to an existing Finding; rule plus location, titles, traces and fuzzy fingerprints yield a candidate requiring policy or an adjudicator.

relations.description: Explicit corroborations of Findings already present in this attempt's input FindingSet.

path.description: Repository-relative path inside the subject snapshot.

line.description: 1-indexed line. Absent when the claim is about the file as a whole.
